note: Both sets correctly capture the ~100 issues and concerns from the initial LCIT reviews across the four mission concepts. Both then add two redundant, misbound claims: the value 100 is attributed to mission concepts (claim 3 in both), when the text says there are four mission concepts and 100 issues/concerns. Set A's second claim is worse — it binds 100 to a 'resultant mission concepts count' and uses a stitched, non-contiguous quote — whereas Set B's second claim at least keeps a contiguous quote, though it still misattributes 100 to findings of the Draft Final Reports rather than issues raised by the reviews.
